{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSGVC5JsxqnXvwsuRajt","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_016eAkbUZehaotFeUyDpkEUA","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083655Z-claude-with-skill-3/workspace/test/AuditYield.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {AccruingAavePool, AccruingAToken} from \"./helpers/AccruingAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice The vault is sold as a *yield* vault. These tests give it a pool that\n///         actually pays interest and check whether any of it reaches depositors.\n/// @dev test/mocks/MockAavePool.sol mints its receipt token 1:1 and has no index,\n///      so the shipped 39-test suite is structurally incapable of observing yield.\ncontract AuditYieldTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    AccruingAavePool internal pool;\n    AccruingAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new AccruingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  totalAssets() is a stored counter, not a measurement.\n\n        totalAssetsStored only ever moves inside deposit()/withdraw().\n        aUsdt.balanceOf(vault) is never read anywhere in src/. So Aave interest\n        raises the vault's real holdings while the share price stays frozen.\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_F2_InterestNeverReachesTheSharePrice() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(100_000e6);\n\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n        uint256 redeemableBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        // Aave pays 5%.\n        pool.accrueInterest(500);\n\n        uint256 realHoldings = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        console.log(\"aUSDT the vault really holds :\", realHoldings);\n        console.log(\"vault.totalAssets()          :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console.log(\"sharePrice before accrual    :\", priceBefore);\n        console.log(\"sharePrice after  accrual    :\", vault.sharePrice());\n        console.log(\"alice redeemable before      :\", redeemableBefore);\n        console.log(\"alice redeemable after       :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice));\n\n        assertEq(realHoldings, 105_000e6, \"Aave really did pay 5%\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 100_000e6, \"but the vault still books the principal\");\n        assertEq(vault.sharePrice(), priceBefore, \"share price does not move\");\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), redeemableBefore, \"alice's claim does not move\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The headline consequence: a depositor loses money over a year in\n    ///         which the vault's underlying position earned 5%.\n    function test_F2_DepositorLosesMoneyDespitePositiveYield() public {\n        uint256 principal = 100_000e6;\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(principal);\n\n        pool.accrueInterest(500); // a year at 5% APY\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 received = vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        uint256 stranded = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        console.log(\"alice deposited              :\", principal);\n        console.log(\"alice received back          :\", received);\n        console.log(\"alice net P&L                : -\", principal - received);\n        console.log(\"interest the position earned :\", uint256(5_000e6));\n        console.log(\"aUSDT stranded in the vault  :\", stranded);\n\n        assertLt(received, principal, \"alice is down on a position that earned 5%\");\n        assertEq(principal - received, 300e6, \"she lost the 0.3% withdraw fee\");\n These tests give it a pool that\n///         actually pays interest and check whether any of it reaches depositors.\n/// @dev test/mocks/MockAavePool.sol mints its receipt token 1:1 and has no index,\n///      so the shipped 39-test suite is structurally incapable of observing yield.\ncontract AuditYieldTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    AccruingAavePool internal pool;\n    AccruingAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new AccruingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  totalAssets() is a stored counter, not a measurement.\n\n        totalAssetsStored only ever moves inside deposit()/withdraw().\n        aUsdt.balanceOf(vault) is never read anywhere in src/. So Aave interest\n        raises the vault's real holdings while the share price stays frozen.\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_F2_InterestNeverReachesTheSharePrice() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(100_000e6);\n\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n        uint256 redeemableBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        // Aave pays 5%.\n        pool.accrueInterest(500);\n\n        uint256 realHoldings = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        console.log(\"aUSDT the vault really holds :\", realHoldings);\n        console.log(\"vault.totalAssets()          :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console.log(\"sharePrice before accrual    :\", priceBefore);\n        console.log(\"sharePrice after  accrual    :\", vault.sharePrice());\n        console.log(\"alice redeemable before      :\", redeemableBefore);\n        console.log(\"alice redeemable after       :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice));\n\n        assertEq(realHoldings, 105_000e6, \"Aave really did pay 5%\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 100_000e6, \"but the vault still books the principal\");\n        assertEq(vault.sharePrice(), priceBefore, \"share price does not move\");\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), redeemableBefore, \"alice's claim does not move\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The headline consequence: a depositor loses money over a year in\n    ///         which the vault's underlying position earned 5%.\n    function test_F2_DepositorLosesMoneyDespitePositiveYield() public {\n        uint256 principal = 100_000e6;\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(principal);\n\n        pool.accrueInterest(500); // a year at 5% APY\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 received = vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        uint256 stranded = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        console.log(\"alice deposited              :\", principal);\n        console.log(\"alice received back          :\", received);\n        console.log(\"alice net P&L                : -\", principal - received);\n        console.log(\"interest the position earned :\", uint256(5_000e6));\n        console.log(\"aUSDT stranded in the vault  :\", stranded);\n\n        assertLt(received, principal, \"alice is down on a position that earned 5%\");\n        assertEq(principal - received, 300e6, \"she lost the 0.3% withdraw fee\");\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore - 300e6);\n\n        // Every cent of the 5,000 USDT of interest is left behind, and the vault\n        // has no function that can ever move it.\n        assertGe(stranded, 5_000e6, \"all interest is stranded\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"with zero shares outstanding, nobody has a claim on it\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Interest accrued before you arrive is not credited either, so the\n    ///         vault never converges on the right price no matter the sequence.\n    function testFuzz_F2_SharePriceIgnoresAnyAmountOfInterest(uint256 principal, uint256 yieldBps) public {\n        principal = bound(principal, 1e6, 500_000e6);\n        yieldBps = bound(yieldBps, 1, 10_000);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(principal);\n\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n        pool.accrueInterest(yieldBps);\n\n        assertGt(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), principal, \"real holdings grew\");\n        assertEq(vault.sharePrice(), priceBefore, \"share price never does\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSGYFPpDSsiiaYXBubtV","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01NJT3KPk8JmvRDGaMvhSmGZ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083655Z-claude-with-skill-3/workspace/test/AuditFork.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {IAavePool} from \"../src/interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice The vault against the actual mainnet contracts it ships against.\n/// @dev Run with:\n///        forge test --match-path test/AuditFork.t.sol -vv\n///      Uses a pinned block so results are reproducible. Override the endpoint with\n///      MAINNET_RPC_URL=<your archive rpc> if the default public one is rate-limited.\ncontract AuditForkTest is Test {\n    address internal constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;\n    address internal constant AAVE_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;\n    address internal constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n\n    uint256 internal constant FORK_BLOCK = 25_600_000;\n    string internal constant DEFAULT_RPC = \"https://eth.drpc.org\";\n\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", DEFAULT_RPC), FORK_BLOCK);\n\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDT, AUSDT, AAVE_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDT, alice, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        // Note we cannot write `IERC20(USDT).approve(...)` here either -- for exactly\n        // the reason this file is about. The test has to use a low-level call.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool ok,) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", address(vault), type(uint256).max));\n        require(ok, \"setup approve failed\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  deposit() reverts against real USDT, 100% of the time.\n\n        UsdtYieldVault.sol:94 calls `usdt.approve(...)` through the IERC20\n        interface, which ABI-decodes a bool from the return data. Real USDT's\n        approve() is declared `public` with no return value and returns 0 bytes,\n        so the decode reverts. SafeERC20 is imported and used for the transfer on\n        line 93, but not for the approve on line 94.\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Control: the Aave V3 USDT reserve is live and accepting supply at this block.\n    function test_F1_Control_RealAaveAcceptsUsdtSupplyDirectly() public {\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        (bool ok,) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, uint256(10_000e6)));\n        require(ok, \"approve failed\");\n        IAavePool(AAVE_POOL).supply(USDT, 10_000e6, alice, 0);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        console.log(\"aUSDT minted to alice by real Aave:\", IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(alice));\n        assertApproxEqAbs(IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(alice), 10_000e6, 1, \"reserve is active\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Real USDT's approve() returns zero bytes, so an IERC20-typed call reverts.\n    function test_F1_RealUsdtApproveReturnsNoData() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool rawOk, bytes memory ret) =\n            USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, uint256(0)));\n\n        console.log(\"raw call succeeded:\", rawOk);\n        console.log(\"return data length:\", ret.length);\n\n        assertTrue(rawOk, \"the raw call itself is fine\");\n        assertEq(ret.length, 0, \"USDT.approve returns no bool\");\n\n        // The exact expression on UsdtYieldVault.sol:94, in isolation.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        IERC20(USDT).approve(AAVE_POOL, 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Therefore every deposit into the shipping vault reverts on mainnet.\n    function test_F1_DepositAlwaysRevertsOnMainnet() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"no shares were ever minted\");\n        assertEq(IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"nothing reached Aave\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Not an edge case: no deposit size works.\n    function testFuzz_F1_NoDepositSizeSucceeds(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 1_000_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  Same yield bug, now against the real Aave V3 pool.\n\n        To get past F-1 we patch ONLY the return value of USDT.approve, via\n        vm.mockCall on that one selector, and pre-set the real allowance the\n        vault's approve() would have set. Everything else in these tests is the\n        unmodified vault, real USDT, and the real Aave V3 pool earning the real\n        supply rate for this reserve.\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function _patchApproveOnly() internal {\n        vm.prank(address(vault));\n        (bool ok,) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, type(uint256).max));\n        require(ok, \"pre-approve failed\");\n        vm.mockCall(USDT, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.approve.selector), abi.encode(true));\n    }\n\n    function test_F2_RealAaveInterestIsStrandedAndDepositorLosesMoney() public {\n        _patchApproveOnly();\n\n        uint256 principal = 1_000_000e6;\n        uint256 balanceBefore = IERC20(USDT).balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(principal);\n\n        uint256 priceAtDeposit = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        uint256 realHoldings = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 interest = realHoldings - principal;\n\n        console.log(\"principal supplied to Aave    :\", principal);\n        console.log(\"aUSDT held after 365 days     :\", realHoldings);\n        console.log(\"real interest earned          :\", interest);\n        console.log(\"vault.totalAssets()           :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console.log(\"sharePrice at deposit         :\", priceAtDeposit);\n        console.log(\"sharePrice after 365 days     :\", vault.sharePrice());\n\n        assertGt(interest, 0, \"real Aave paid real interest\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), principal, \"the vault never noticed\");\n        assertEq(vault.sharePrice(), priceAtDeposit, \"share price is frozen\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 received = vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        uint256 stranded = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        console.log(\"alice received back           :\", received);\n        console.log(\"alice net P&L                 : -\", principal - received);\n        console.log(\"aUSDT stranded in the vault   :\", stranded);\n\n        assertLt(received, principal, \"alice is down after a year of positive yield\");\n        assertEq(IERC20(USDT).balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore - 3_000e6, \"she paid the 0.3% exit fee\");\n        assertGe(stranded, interest, \"the whole yield stays behind\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"and no share exists that could claim it\");\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":654,"cache_read_input_tokens":78196,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":654},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ef06dcc0-c456-4ae8-9b1a-06956807da6b","uuid":"493e7912-c72c-453f-94ef-978137640e0e","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:45:42.124Z","request_id":"req_011CdSGYDyjiYNuiX5252fwF"}

Override the endpoint with\n///      MAINNET_RPC_URL=<your archive rpc> if the default public one is rate-limited.\ncontract AuditForkTest is Test {\n    address internal constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;\n    address internal constant AAVE_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;\n    address internal constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n\n    uint256 internal constant FORK_BLOCK = 25_600_000;\n    string internal constant DEFAULT_RPC = \"https://eth.drpc.org\";\n\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", DEFAULT_RPC), FORK_BLOCK);\n\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDT, AUSDT, AAVE_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDT, alice, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        // Note we cannot write `IERC20(USDT).approve(...)` here either -- for exactly\n        // the reason this file is about. The test has to use a low-level call.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool ok,) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", address(vault), type(uint256).max));\n        require(ok, \"setup approve failed\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  deposit() reverts against real USDT, 100% of the time.\n\n        UsdtYieldVault.sol:94 calls `usdt.approve(...)` through the IERC20\n        interface, which ABI-decodes a bool from the return data. Real USDT's\n        approve() is declared `public` with no return value and returns 0 bytes,\n        so the decode reverts. SafeERC20 is imported and used for the transfer on\n        line 93, but not for the approve on line 94.\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Control: the Aave V3 USDT reserve is live and accepting supply at this block.\n    function test_F1_Control_RealAaveAcceptsUsdtSupplyDirectly() public {\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        (bool ok,) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, uint256(10_000e6)));\n        require(ok, \"approve failed\");\n        IAavePool(AAVE_POOL).supply(USDT, 10_000e6, alice, 0);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        console.log(\"aUSDT minted to alice by real Aave:\", IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(alice));\n        assertApproxEqAbs(IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(alice), 10_000e6, 1, \"reserve is active\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Real USDT's approve() returns zero bytes, so an IERC20-typed call reverts.\n    function test_F1_RealUsdtApproveReturnsNoData() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool rawOk, bytes memory ret) =\n            USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, uint256(0)));\n\n        console.log(\"raw call succeeded:\", rawOk);\n        console.log(\"return data length:\", ret.length);\n\n        assertTrue(rawOk, \"the raw call itself is fine\");\n        assertEq(ret.length, 0, \"USDT.approve returns no bool\");\n\n        // The exact expression on UsdtYieldVault.sol:94, in isolation.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        IERC20(USDT).approve(AAVE_POOL, 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Therefore every deposit into the shipping vault reverts on mainnet.\n    function test_F1_DepositAlwaysRevertsOnMainnet() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"no shares were ever minted\");\n        assertEq(IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"nothing reached Aave\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Not an edge case: no deposit size works.\n    function testFuzz_F1_NoDepositSizeSucceeds(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 1_000_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  Same yield bug, now against the real Aave V3 pool.\n\n        To get past F-1 we patch ONLY the return value of USDT.approve, via\n        vm.mockCall on that one selector, and pre-set the real allowance the\n        vault's approve() would have set. Everything else in these tests is the\n        unmodified vault, real USDT, and the real Aave V3 pool earning the real\n        supply rate for this reserve.\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function _patchApproveOnly() internal {\n        vm.prank(address(vault));\n        (bool ok,) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, type(uint256).max));\n        require(ok, \"pre-approve failed\");\n        vm.mockCall(USDT, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.approve.selector), abi.encode(true));\n    }\n\n    function test_F2_RealAaveInterestIsStrandedAndDepositorLosesMoney() public {\n        _patchApproveOnly();\n\n        uint256 principal = 1_000_000e6;\n        uint256 balanceBefore = IERC20(USDT).balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(principal);\n\n        uint256 priceAtDeposit = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        uint256 realHoldings = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 interest = realHoldings - principal;\n\n        console.log(\"principal supplied to Aave    :\", principal);\n        console.log(\"aUSDT held after 365 days     :\", realHoldings);\n        console.log(\"real interest earned          :\", interest);\n        console.log(\"vault.totalAssets()           :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console.log(\"sharePrice at deposit         :\", priceAtDeposit);\n        console.log(\"sharePrice after 365 days     :\", vault.sharePrice());\n\n        assertGt(interest, 0, \"real Aave paid real interest\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), principal, \"the vault never noticed\");\n        assertEq(vault.sharePrice(), priceAtDeposit, \"share price is frozen\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 received = vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        uint256 stranded = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        console.log(\"alice received back           :\", received);\n        console.log(\"alice net P&L                 : -\", principal - received);\n        console.log(\"aUSDT stranded in the vault   :\", stranded);\n\n        assertLt(received, principal, \"alice is down after a year of positive yield\");\n        assertEq(IERC20(USDT).balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore - 3_000e6, \"she paid the 0.3% exit fee\");\n        assertGe(stranded, interest, \"the whole yield stays behind\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"and no share exists that could claim it\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

Override the endpoint with\n///      MAINNET_RPC_URL=<your archive rpc> if the default public one is rate-limited.\ncontract AuditForkTest is Test {\n    address internal constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;\n    address internal constant AAVE_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;\n    address internal constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n\n    uint256 internal constant FORK_BLOCK = 25_600_000;\n    string internal constant DEFAULT_RPC = \"https://eth.drpc.org\";\n\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", DEFAULT_RPC), FORK_BLOCK);\n\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDT, AUSDT, AAVE_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDT, alice, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        // Note we cannot write `IERC20(USDT).approve(...)` here either -- for exactly\n        // the reason this file is about. The test has to use a low-level call.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool ok,) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", address(vault), type(uint256).max));\n        require(ok, \"setup approve failed\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  deposit() reverts against real USDT, 100% of the time.\n\n        UsdtYieldVault.sol:94 calls `usdt.approve(...)` through the IERC20\n        interface, which ABI-decodes a bool from the return data. Real USDT's\n        approve() is declared `public` with no return value and returns 0 bytes,\n        so the decode reverts. SafeERC20 is imported and used for the transfer on\n        line 93, but not for the approve on line 94.\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Control: the Aave V3 USDT reserve is live and accepting supply at this block.\n    function test_F1_Control_RealAaveAcceptsUsdtSupplyDirectly() public {\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        (bool ok,) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, uint256(10_000e6)));\n        require(ok, \"approve failed\");\n        IAavePool(AAVE_POOL).supply(USDT, 10_000e6, alice, 0);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        console.log(\"aUSDT minted to alice by real Aave:\", IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(alice));\n        assertApproxEqAbs(IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(alice), 10_000e6, 1, \"reserve is active\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Real USDT's approve() returns zero bytes, so an IERC20-typed call reverts.\n    function test_F1_RealUsdtApproveReturnsNoData() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool rawOk, bytes memory ret) =\n            USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, uint256(0)));\n\n        console.log(\"raw call succeeded:\", rawOk);\n        console.log(\"return data length:\", ret.length);\n\n        assertTrue(rawOk, \"the raw call itself is fine\");\n        assertEq(ret.length, 0, \"USDT.approve returns no bool\");\n\n        // The exact expression on UsdtYieldVault.sol:94, in isolation.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        IERC20(USDT).approve(AAVE_POOL, 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Therefore every deposit into the shipping vault reverts on mainnet.\n    function test_F1_DepositAlwaysRevertsOnMainnet() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"no shares were ever minted\");\n        assertEq(IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"nothing reached Aave\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Not an edge case: no deposit size works.\n    function testFuzz_F1_NoDepositSizeSucceeds(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 1_000_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  Same yield bug, now against the real Aave V3 pool.\n\n        To get past F-1 we patch ONLY the return value of USDT.approve, via\n        vm.mockCall on that one selector, and pre-set the real allowance the\n        vault's approve() would have set. Everything else in these tests is the\n        unmodified vault, real USDT, and the real Aave V3 pool earning the real\n        supply rate for this reserve.\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function _patchApproveOnly() internal {\n        vm.prank(address(vault));\n        (bool ok,) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, type(uint256).max));\n        require(ok, \"pre-approve failed\");\n        vm.mockCall(USDT, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.approve.selector), abi.encode(true));\n    }\n\n    function test_F2_RealAaveInterestIsStrandedAndDepositorLosesMoney() public {\n        _patchApproveOnly();\n\n        uint256 principal = 1_000_000e6;\n        uint256 balanceBefore = IERC20(USDT).balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(principal);\n\n        uint256 priceAtDeposit = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        uint256 realHoldings = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 interest = realHoldings - principal;\n\n        console.log(\"principal supplied to Aave    :\", principal);\n        console.log(\"aUSDT held after 365 days     :\", realHoldings);\n        console.log(\"real interest earned          :\", interest);\n        console.log(\"vault.totalAssets()           :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console.log(\"sharePrice at deposit         :\", priceAtDeposit);\n        console.log(\"sharePrice after 365 days     :\", vault.sharePrice());\n\n        assertGt(interest, 0, \"real Aave paid real interest\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), principal, \"the vault never noticed\");\n        assertEq(vault.sharePrice(), priceAtDeposit, \"share price is frozen\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 received = vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        uint256 stranded = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        console.log(\"alice received back           :\", received);\n        console.log(\"alice net P&L                 : -\", principal - received);\n        console.log(\"aUSDT stranded in the vault   :\", stranded);\n\n        assertLt(received, principal, \"alice is down after a year of positive yield\");\n        assertEq(IERC20(USDT).balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore - 3_000e6, \"she paid the 0.3% exit fee\");\n        assertGe(stranded, interest, \"the whole yield stays behind\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"and no share exists that could claim it\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":7,"oldLines":6,"newStart":7,"newLines":14,"lines":[" import {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";"," import {IAavePool} from \"../src/interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";"," ","+/// @notice Stands in for the vault: makes the same IERC20-typed approve call that","+///         UsdtYieldVault.sol:94 makes, from its own frame.","+contract ApproveProbe {","+    function typedApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {","+        return IERC20(token).approve(spender, amount);","+    }","+}","+"," /// @notice The vault against the actual mainnet contracts it ships against."," /// @dev Run with:"," ///        forge test --match-path test/AuditFork.t.sol -vv"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ef06dcc0-c456-4ae8-9b1a-06956807da6b","uuid":"38044d4c-2e6a-4e39-a79e-349b0b00059a","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:46:30.524Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083655Z-claude-with-skill-3/workspace/test/AuditFork.t.sol","oldString":"    address internal constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;","newString":"    address internal constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n    address internal constant USDC = 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48;","originalFile":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {IAavePool} from \"../src/interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Stands in for the vault: makes the same IERC20-typed approve call that\n///         UsdtYieldVault.sol:94 makes, from its own frame.\ncontract ApproveProbe {\n    function typedApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {\n        return IERC20(token).approve(spender, amount);\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice The vault against the actual mainnet contracts it ships against.\n/// @dev Run with:\n///        forge test --match-path test/AuditFork.t.sol -vv\n///      Uses a pinned block so results are reproducible. Override the endpoint with\n///      MAINNET_RPC_URL=<your archive rpc> if the default public one is rate-limited.\ncontract AuditForkTest is Test {\n    address internal constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;\n    address internal constant AAVE_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;\n    address internal constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n\n    uint256 internal constant FORK_BLOCK = 25_600_000;\n    string internal constant DEFAULT_RPC = \"https://eth.drpc.org\";\n\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", DEFAULT_RPC), FORK_BLOCK);\n\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDT, AUSDT, AAVE_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDT, alice, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        // Note we cannot write `IERC20(USDT).approve(...)` here either -- for exactly\n        // the reason this file is about. The test has to use a low-level call.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool ok,) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", address(vault), type(uint256).max));\n        require(ok, \"setup approve failed\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  deposit() reverts against real USDT, 100% of the time.\n\n        UsdtYieldVault.sol:94 calls `usdt.approve(...)` through the IERC20\n        interface, which ABI-decodes a bool from the return data. Real USDT's\n        approve() is declared `public` with no return value and returns 0 bytes,\n        so the decode reverts. SafeERC20 is imported and used for the transfer on\n        line 93, but not for the approve on line 94.\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Control: the Aave V3 USDT reserve is live and accepting supply at this block.\n    function test_F1_Control_RealAaveAcceptsUsdtSupplyDirectly() public {\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        (bool ok,) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, uint256(10_000e6)));\n        require(ok, \"approve failed\");\n        IAavePool(AAVE_POOL).supply(USDT, 10_000e6, alice, 0);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        console.log(\"aUSDT minted to alice by real Aave:\", IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(alice));\n        assertApproxEqAbs(IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(alice), 10_000e6, 1, \"reserve is active\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Real USDT's approve() returns zero bytes, so an IERC20-typed call reverts.\n    function test_F1_RealUsdtApproveReturnsNoData() public {\n        (bool rawOk, bytes memory ret) =\n            USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, uint256(0)));\n\n        console.log(\"raw USDT.approve call succeeded:\", rawOk);\n        console.log(\"USDT.approve return data length:\", ret.length);\n\n        assertTrue(rawOk, \"the raw call itself is fine\");\n        assertEq(ret.length, 0, \"USDT.approve returns no bool\");\n\n        // The exact expression on UsdtYieldVault.sol:94, in a contract frame.\n        ApproveProbe probe = new ApproveProbe();\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        probe.typedApprove(USDT, AAVE_POOL, 0);\n\n        // Contrast: the identical call against a compliant token on the same fork.\n        assertTrue(probe.typedApprove(USDC, AAVE_POOL, 0), \"USDC returns a bool and decodes fine\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Therefore every deposit into the shipping vault reverts on mainnet.\n    function test_F1_DepositAlwaysRevertsOnMainnet() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"no shares were ever minted\");\n        assertEq(IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"nothing reached Aave\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Not an edge case: no deposit size works.\n    function testFuzz_F1_NoDepositSizeSucceeds(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 1_000_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  Same yield bug, now against the real Aave V3 pool.\n\n        To get past F-1 we patch ONLY the return value of USDT.approve, via\n        vm.mockCall on that one selector, and pre-set the real allowance the\n        vault's approve() would have set. Everything else in these tests is the\n        unmodified vault, real USDT, and the real Aave V3 pool earning the real\n        supply rate for this reserve.\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function _patchApproveOnly() internal {\n        vm.prank(address(vault));\n        (bool ok,) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, type(uint256).max));\n        require(ok, \"pre-approve failed\");\n        vm.mockCall(USDT, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.approve.selector), abi.encode(true));\n    }\n\n    function test_F2_RealAaveInterestIsStrandedAndDepositorLosesMoney() public {\n        _patchApproveOnly();\n\n        uint256 principal = 1_000_000e6;\n        uint256 balanceBefore = IERC20(USDT).balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(principal);\n\n        uint256 priceAtDeposit = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        uint256 realHoldings = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 interest = realHoldings - principal;\n\n        console.log(\"principal supplied to Aave    :\", principal);\n        console.log(\"aUSDT held after 365 days     :\", realHoldings);\n        console.log(\"real interest earned          :\", interest);\n        console.log(\"vault.totalAssets()           :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console.log(\"sharePrice at deposit         :\", priceAtDeposit);\n        console.log(\"sharePrice after 365 days     :\", vault.sharePrice());\n\n        assertGt(interest, 0, \"real Aave paid real interest\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), principal, \"the vault never noticed\");\n        assertEq(vault.sharePrice(), priceAtDeposit, \"share price is frozen\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 received = vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        uint256 stranded = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        console.log(\"alice received back           :\", received);\n        console.log(\"alice net P&L                 : -\", principal - received);\n        console.log(\"aUSDT stranded in the vault   :\", stranded);\n\n        assertLt(received, principal, \"alice is down after a year of positive yield\");\n        assertEq(IERC20(USDT).balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore - 3_000e6, \"she paid the 0.3% exit fee\");\n        assertGe(stranded, interest, \"the whole yield stays behind\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"and no share exists that could claim it\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":24,"oldLines":6,"newStart":24,"newLines":7,"lines":["     address internal constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;","     address internal constant AAVE_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;","     address internal constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;","+    address internal constant USDC = 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48;"," ","     uint256 internal constant FORK_BLOCK = 25_600_000;","     string internal constant DEFAULT_RPC = \"https://eth.drpc.org\";"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSGeqcmosNoWngCqe7tB","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01BBijda9tWaiyn3tK6Y1gE5","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083655Z-claude-with-skill-3/workspace/test/AuditInvariant.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"./mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Drives random deposit/withdraw sequences across three actors.\ncontract VaultHandler is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    address[] internal actors;\n    address internal currentActor;\n\n    uint256 public depositCount;\n    uint256 public withdrawCount;\n\n    constructor(UsdtYieldVault _vault, MockUSDT _usdt, address[] memory _actors) {\n        vault = _vault;\n        usdt = _usdt;\n        actors = _actors;\n    }\n\n    modifier useActor(uint256 seed) {\n        currentActor = actors[bound(seed, 0, actors.length - 1)];\n        vm.startPrank(currentActor);\n        _;\n        vm.stopPrank();\n    }\n\n    function deposit(uint256 seed, uint256 amount) external useActor(seed) {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 100_000e6);\n        if (usdt.balanceOf(currentActor) < amount) return;\n        vault.deposit(amount);\n        depositCount++;\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 seed, uint256 shares) external useActor(seed) {\n        uint256 max = vault.shareBalance(currentActor);\n        if (max == 0) return;\n        shares = bound(shares, 1, max);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n        withdrawCount++;\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Properties that must hold across any sequence of user actions.\n/// @dev The shipped suite has no invariant tests at all.\ncontract AuditInvariantTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n    VaultHandler internal handler;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        address[] memory actors = new address[](3);\n        actors[0] = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n        actors[1] = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n        actors[2] = makeAddr(\"carol\");\n\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            usdt.mint(actors[i], 10_000_000e6);\n            vm.prank(actors[i]);\n            usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        }\n\n        handler = new VaultHandler(vault, usdt, actors);\n        targetContract(address(handler));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice EXPECTED TO FAIL. Every USDT the vault holds in Aave should be\n    ///         claimable by some shareholder. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSGifq2J2nguXb23UgBh","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Hk1sye6RY84vvmcbH2Umry","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083655Z-claude-with-skill-3/workspace/test/AuditSpec.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {AccruingAavePool, AccruingAToken} from \"./helpers/AccruingAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice The promises this vault makes, written as assertions.\n///\n/// Every test here asserts the *specified* behaviour taken from README.md and the\n/// NatSpec on src/UsdtYieldVault.sol. They are expected to FAIL against the contract\n/// as it stands. This suite is the sign-off checklist: it should be green before\n/// this contract holds real money.\n///\n/// Run:  forge test --match-path test/AuditSpec.t.sol -vv\ncontract AuditSpecTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    AccruingAavePool internal pool;\n    AccruingAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new AccruingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        address[3] memory actors = [owner, alice, bob];\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            usdt.mint(actors[i], 1_000_000e6);\n            vm.prank(actors[i]);\n            usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address account, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(account);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /// SPEC: \"Pooled USDT vault that routes deposits into Aave V3\" — a depositor's\n    /// claim must grow as the Aave position earns interest.\n    function test_SPEC_YieldAccruesToDepositors() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 100_000e6);\n        uint256 before = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        pool.accrueInterest(500); // Aave pays 5%\n\n        assertGt(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), before, \"depositor's claim must grow with the yield\");\n    }\n\n    /// SPEC: a depositor in a vault whose position earned 5% must not end the year\n    /// with less USDT than they started with.\n    function test_SPEC_DepositorIsNotWorseOffAfterAProfitableYear() public {\n        uint256 principal = 100_000e6;\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(principal);\n\n        pool.accrueInterest(500);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertGt(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore, \"a year at 5% should leave the depositor up\");\n    }\n\n    /// SPEC (README): \"Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to the remaining\n    /// shareholders — they are not swept to the owner.\"\n    function test_SPEC_WithdrawFeeAccruesToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 1_000e6);\n        _deposit(bob, 1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        uint256 bobBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n        uint256 fee = (vault.convertToAssets(aliceShares) * vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS()) / vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n\n        assertApproxEqAbs(\n            vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob) - bobBefore, fee, 1, \"bob must receive the fee alice paid\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// SPEC: every asset the vault holds belongs to somebody. No value may become\n    /// permanently unreachable.\n    function test_SPEC_NoValueBecomesUnreachable() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 1_000e6);\n        _deposit(bob, 1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.shareBalance(bob);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.withdraw(bobShares);\n\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"nothing may be left behind once all shares are burned\");\n    }\n\n    /// SPEC: the deposit fee is a fee, not a confiscation. It must be bounded so the\n    /// owner cannot appropriate a depositor's principal.\n    function test_SPEC_DepositFeeIsBounded() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(9_999);\n\n        _deposit(alice, 100_000e6);\n\n        assertGe(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), 90_000e6, \"a deposit must not lose more than a plausible fee\");\n    }\n\n    /// SPEC: pausing is a safety brake on new risk, not a lock on user money.\n    /// Depositors must always be able to exit.\n    function test_SPEC_PauseDoesNotBlockExit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 10_000e6);\n        uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares); // must not revert\n\n        assertGt(usdt.balanceOf(alice), 990_000e6, \"alice got her money out\");\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1638,"cache_read_input_tokens":90399,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1638},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ef06dcc0-c456-4ae8-9b1a-06956807da6b","uuid":"24f47e11-5d2b-4864-8d79-42f866cc2b97","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:48:04.792Z","request_id":"req_011CdSGidLD8Zi6wPHUxUPab"}

i < actors.length; i++) {\n            usdt.mint(actors[i], 1_000_000e6);\n            vm.prank(actors[i]);\n            usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address account, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(account);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /// SPEC: \"Pooled USDT vault that routes deposits into Aave V3\" — a depositor's\n    /// claim must grow as the Aave position earns interest.\n    function test_SPEC_YieldAccruesToDepositors() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 100_000e6);\n        uint256 before = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        pool.accrueInterest(500); // Aave pays 5%\n\n        assertGt(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), before, \"depositor's claim must grow with the yield\");\n    }\n\n    /// SPEC: a depositor in a vault whose position earned 5% must not end the year\n    /// with less USDT than they started with.\n    function test_SPEC_DepositorIsNotWorseOffAfterAProfitableYear() public {\n        uint256 principal = 100_000e6;\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(principal);\n\n        pool.accrueInterest(500);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertGt(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore, \"a year at 5% should leave the depositor up\");\n    }\n\n    /// SPEC (README): \"Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to the remaining\n    /// shareholders — they are not swept to the owner.\"\n    function test_SPEC_WithdrawFeeAccruesToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 1_000e6);\n        _deposit(bob, 1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        uint256 bobBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n        uint256 fee = (vault.convertToAssets(aliceShares) * vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS()) / vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n\n        assertApproxEqAbs(\n            vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob) - bobBefore, fee, 1, \"bob must receive the fee alice paid\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// SPEC: every asset the vault holds belongs to somebody. No value may become\n    /// permanently unreachable.\n    function test_SPEC_NoValueBecomesUnreachable() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 1_000e6);\n        _deposit(bob, 1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.shareBalance(bob);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.withdraw(bobShares);\n\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"nothing may be left behind once all shares are burned\");\n    }\n\n    /// SPEC: the deposit fee is a fee, not a confiscation. It must be bounded so the\n    /// owner cannot appropriate a depositor's principal.\n    function test_SPEC_DepositFeeIsBounded() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(9_999);\n\n        _deposit(alice, 100_000e6);\n\n        assertGe(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), 90_000e6, \"a deposit must not lose more than a plausible fee\");\n    }\n\n    /// SPEC: pausing is a safety brake on new risk, not a lock on user money.\n    /// Depositors must always be able to exit.\n    function test_SPEC_PauseDoesNotBlockExit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 10_000e6);\n        uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares); // must not revert\n\n        assertGt(usdt.balanceOf(alice), 990_000e6, \"alice got her money out\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":110,"oldLines":6,"newStart":110,"newLines":9,"lines":["     /// SPEC: the deposit fee is a fee, not a confiscation. It must be bounded so the","     /// owner cannot appropriate a depositor's principal.","     function test_SPEC_DepositFeeIsBounded() public {","+        // Someone must already hold shares for the fee to have anywhere to go.","+        _deposit(owner, 1_000e6);","+","         vm.prank(owner);","         vault.setDepositFee(9_999);"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}
